rule: Art. 6(1) AIA with Annex I, Sections A and B, and Art. 2(2) AIA, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (machinery moved to Section B)

sources.pinpoint: Art. 6(1)(a), (b); Annex I, Sections A and B (original lists)
Art. 1, point (41)(a): Annex I, Section A, point 1 deleted; Art. 1, point (41)(b): Section B, point 21 (Regulation (EU) 2023/1230) added; Art. 4
Art. 1, point (40)(b): Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c)(ii)

interpretations.text: Art. 2(2) read literally lists neither Art. 5 nor Art. 50 for a Section B product. Dropping a hard stop on a contested reading is the costlier error, so the report keeps both findings and raises an open question for Art. 5 where a prohibition applies or a point (ba) or (bb) is met, and for Art. 50 wherever an Art. 50 duty is triggered.

Where the Art. 6(1) conditions are asserted but neither the Annex I legislation nor the section is given, the report keeps the Section A duties and goes to review; it does not silently treat the product as Section A.

Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, Art. 1, point (41), deleted Annex I, Section A, point 1 and added Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 as Section B, point 21. Its Art. 4 sets entry into force on the third day after publication (OJ of 24 July 2026), so 27 July 2026, and no later date for point (41). Machinery is a Section B act; no Chapter III date changes, as the Annex I duties start on 2 August 2028.

cases.facts: A safety component of a toy (Directive 2009/48/EC, Annex I, Section A, point 2) that needs third-party conformity assessment.
A safety component of machinery under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 that needs third-party conformity assessment: Section B, point 21, so Art. 2(2) applies.
A safety component of a motor vehicle under Regulation (EU) 2018/858 (Section B, point 18).
The profile gives Section B without naming the act; the section decides as before.
A Section B machinery component that also interacts with natural persons. Art. 2(2) read literally lists no Art. 50; the report keeps the Art. 50(1) duty and raises the question.
The Art. 6(1) conditions are asserted, but neither the Annex I legislation nor the section is given.
The profile names machinery (Section B, point 21) but gives Section A.
Machinery that needs no third-party conformity assessment does not meet Art. 6(1)(b); the act is reported as not used.
A Section B motor-vehicle component that is also a remote biometric identification system (Annex III, point 1(a)).
A Section B machinery component that performs emotion recognition in the workplace (Art. 5(1)(f)). The prohibition is kept and the Art. 2(2) question raised.
Annex I, Section A, point 1 (Directive 2006/42/EC) was deleted by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and is not a valid act.
